_comment: Edit this file to change equipment specs. Backend loads this on startup.
_demand_factors: peak_kw = gen_kva × demand_factor (used for non-exact-match kVA sizes)
_demand_factor_basis: Tower Crane 0.28 derived from Wolffkran real data (rated_kva x 0.8 PF x 0.75 motor diversity ÷ gen_kva). Generator is 3-4x oversized vs running demand due to starting surge requirements.

equipment_specs._comment: gen_size_kva is reference only (cost/savings). peak_kw drives load calcs.
equipment_specs._tower_crane_basis: Peak kW aligned to Wolffkran real data: rated_kva x 0.8 (PF) x 0.75 (motor diversity). Generic variants match nearest Wolffkran equivalent by generator size.

Tower Crane (Small)._equiv: Scaled from Wolffkran WK6017 (125kVA gen, 34.8kW peak)

util_by_type._comment: Displayed in Quick Calc UI panel (must match demand factors above)
